details.description: WHILE TESTING POWER TONG NOTICED THE MOTOR WAS ACTING UP THE HI GEAR WAS ON ALL THE TIME COUDING GET IT TO LOW GEAR
While doing hazard hunt before rig goes to Exxon found 2 extinguishers missing annual inspections.

recent_findings.concern: All we're using ski ropes and staying clear of the line of fire.
recent_findings.positive: All handles were being used on the slips and 2 crew members were latching the elevator.

recent_findings.concern: Did it observe any.
recent_findings.positive: Vdoor operator was cautious while removing the handling plug, insuring it was made all the way up every time.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Crew was all wearing their proper PPE and was doing a great job working with each other and the rig crew

recent_findings.concern: This crew is very observant of the pinch points. The rig floor was pretty clean considering the amount of pipe racked back in the derrick.
recent_findings.positive: Vdoor operator was able to communicate very well with the driller and was giving clear hand signals.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: 2 crew members double checked all ski ropes and insured al keeper were in place.

recent_findings.concern: Only issue that was observed was the employee standing in the line of fire while making a connection. It was corrected immediately.
recent_findings.positive: While rigging up, all employees were giving clear hand signals to the hoist operator and maintained a good line of site.

recent_findings.concern: Only unsafe practices observed were submitted on observation card.
recent_findings.positive: While rigging up crew members were very observant and communicated well with the air hoist operator. Hand and visual conformation was established.

recent_findings.concern: No issues no concerns did take the opportunity to talk to the crew about the most recent safety alert
recent_findings.positive: N/A

recent_findings.concern: No issues today.
recent_findings.positive: Good communication with driller and between casing crew members.

recent_findings.concern: Good hand placement , good body positioning
recent_findings.positive: Good communication between driller, skate operator and rough necks. rig running at a good pace,

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: While rigging down, the crew used hold back line to remove equipment from floor.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Very good clear flagging method was used.

recent_findings.customer: New Customer - Request addition to KPA
recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Crew staying aware of pipe being hoisted into derrick.

recent_findings.concern: Couple issues of hand positioning that we addressed. Body positioning was good.
recent_findings.positive: Good communication between crew members.

recent_findings.concern: Observed some body placement concerns and addressed them while I was there. Please see observation above.
recent_findings.positive: Good communication between SSE and mentors during the job. The crew said that the company made sure that everyone was aware of our SSE during the safety meeting so that everyone could look out for him.

recent_findings.concern: Crew member had his hand at the bottom of the ear while latching. It was clear of pinch points but asked that he place it a little lower on the body of the elevator ls instead. Also crew had the stabbing guide on top of the ST-80. I know that isn't an issue with all rigs we go to but Chevron and Pat
recent_findings.positive: Good teamwork and communication between crew members.

recent_findings.concern: While trying to make up a slightly bent joint, crew members were stepping into the swing radius to look up and see which way the driller needed to extend the elevators. Made them aware and reminded them to step back a bit.
recent_findings.positive: After trying for a bit to make up a joint, crew stopped the job and held a tailgate meeting with the driller to determine whether or not to pay the joint out.

recent_findings.concern: Crew member holding onto the ski rope as casing was being made up. We did discuss the potential for injury.
recent_findings.positive: Mentor doing a good job of explaing things.

recent_findings.concern: These guys work well together as are looking out for one another.
recent_findings.positive: FMS operator is constantly waiting for driller to give verification before opening and closing.

recent_findings.concern: Everyone is being very observant and working well together.
recent_findings.positive: All crew members were pulling and setting slips together.
